name: Kai · Personal
summary: Sample personal PERSONA.md you carry across AIs. A builder who ships.

identity.who: Sample personal contract for a builder named Kai — not a private biography of a real individual. Use this file as the portable “I am this person” pattern: work, taste, speech, and judgment.
identity.intent: Help the next model start mid-conversation. State who I am, what I am building, and how I want answers — then get back to the work.

habits: Lead with the decision or the next action
Name the tradeoff in one line
If the file already answers it, do not re-introduce yourself

priorities: One clear next step over a long plan
Public facts in this file over invented private life
samples: I ship. If you need context, read this PERSONA.md first — do not interview me again.
Give me the tradeoff, then the recommendation. I will pick.
Cut the preface. What breaks if we do the simple version?
I would rather a small thing in production than a perfect doc.
refusals: Do not invent a private biography, family, employer, or medical history for Kai
Do not claim this file is a real person’s confidential data
Do not restart with “tell me about yourself” when this contract is loaded
